about: D1 attribution evidence: local, non-model evidence on which credential source the pinned codex-cli 0.160.0 uses. No model call, no token text, no secret read; credential manager entries are recorded by target name shape only.

executable.note: isolation.executable_identity of the codex launcher on PATH resolves to this native package binary

not_established: a complete credential access trace of the authenticated execution route: no file and registry access monitor is installed on this machine (Process Monitor absent), so none was recorded
binary and payload bound implementation analysis beyond string evidence

os_credential_store.key_derivation: the 16 hex characters equal the first 16 of sha256 over the UTF-8 extended length path \\?\<owner home>\.codex
os_credential_store.method: cmdkey /list (target names only; no secret read), Windows Credential Manager of the owner
os_credential_store.reading: the only Codex entry in the OS credential store is keyed by a hash of the owner CODEX_HOME path (~/.codex), not by account data; no entry exists for the baseline path or any worker path. It belongs to secret_auth_storage, which the frozen route disables (--disable secret_auth_storage)

route_binding: the frozen argv carries -c cli_auth_credentials_store="file" and --disable secret_auth_storage (config.ROUTE_SECURITY_ARGS, config.DISABLE_FEATURES), enforced by isolation.argv_check and verify_launch

the telemetry certificate adds the scrambled token exec probe at a worker path (account metadata of the baseline kept, tokens no server accepts): an account indexed credential store would authenticate it; an authentication failure without reply or usage excludes that counterexample on the actual route

static_strings.keyring_service: the string Codex Auth sits next to the error text failed to delete auth from keyring: the OS keyring service name of the keyring store
static_strings.method: grep -a -o -F counts over the pinned codex.exe

status: partial: this annex records static, black-box and credential store evidence. It meets Astra's D1 requirement only if Opus B rules this evidence, together with the telemetry scrambled token probe, acceptable (the joint decision names a credential access trace as the cheapest closing item)

store_selection_black_box.method: codex login status in fresh empty CODEX_HOME copies at a harness worker path (Isolation.empty_home, isolation.child_env, run.run_local), one fresh home per command
store_selection_black_box.reading: the configuration knob accepts exactly file, keyring, auto and ephemeral (a bogus value is refused); with no auth.json at the worker path no store, the OS keyring included, yields a credential for that path
